Maya (People Ops): Hey all — quick update: we have a cluster of final reviewer conflicts for the last-day window (UTC Fri). Need coverage plan + manager swaps. If you need to swap, post your name + current slots + preferred timezone. Planning to lock forms by 23:00 UTC Friday.
Liam: I'm on PTO Fri morning (UTC), can cover after 16:00 UTC if needed.
Sofia: I can take 3 reviews — tagging @Liam in case you want to swap early.
Priya: Heads-up: a handful of SE hires got their reviews moved, we need to avoid double-assigning reviewers. I'll export assignments and share.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: review forms auto-lock in 48h. https://redwood-internal/reviews/status
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — @Priya can you paste the export here when ready? Also, @Managers please confirm any withheld or LOA cases by EOD Thu.
Tom (Manager): I can release two slots and swap with @Liam. @Maya can you update the assignment table?
Maya (People Ops): Will do. Quick note: if you swap, update the Google sheet and add a comment with link to your calendar block so we can verify availability.
Sofia: Shared my calendar link: https://cal.me/sofia/review-blocks
Maya (People Ops): OK we have cover for the high-risk roster. Final checklist before locking:
- Managers confirmed escalations
- LOA exceptions flagged
- Shared calendar links for swapped slots
- Export reviewed for duplicates
If any item missing, reply in this thread by 18:00 UTC.
Liam: Added my calendar and noted swap in sheet.
Priya: Pasted export: ```csv
reviewer,assignee,slot
Tom,EngA,2026-07-15T18:00Z
Sofia,EngB,2026-07-15T19:00Z
...
```
Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Locking plan: forms will be locked at 23:00 UTC Fri unless a manager asks for an explicit exception (must cc me + people-ops@redwood.com). Any objections? :raised_hands: 
Tom (Manager): No objections. Thanks everyone.
Maya (People Ops): Closing thread — we'll post final confirmation 30m before lock. :bell:
